connect.errorEmailRequired: A valid email address is required.

connect.errorPortRange: That port is not valid. Ports must be between 1 and 65535.
connect.errorNetwork: Network error. Please check your connection and try again.
connect.errorAuthShort: The mail server rejected that password.
connect.errorAuthMechanismShort: This server does not offer a login method we support.
connect.errorTimeoutShort: The server did not answer in time.
connect.errorSecurityShort: The security mode does not match the port.
connect.errorLoginTakenShort: That mailbox login is already connected.
connect.errorProtocolShort: The mail server sent an unexpected reply.
connect.errorHostNotFoundShort: That server name does not exist.
connect.errorRepeatHint: Same result twice. Check the username, the password, and the security mode before trying again.
connect.errorAuthImapDisabled: IMAP access is switched off for this mailbox.
connect.errorAuthAppPassword: {provider} will not accept your normal password here.
connect.errorAuthAccountPassword: That looks like your normal password, not a {provider} app password.
connect.errorAuthAppPasswordLength: That is not a complete {provider} app password.
connect.errorAuthLoginName: The mail server did not recognise that login name.
connect.imapDisabledDetail: Turn IMAP access on in your mail account settings, then connect again. No password can work until it is on.
connect.appPasswordRequiredDetail: An app password is a separate credential you generate in your account settings. Two-factor authentication has to be on before the option appears.
connect.appPasswordAccountDetail: An app password is generated for you, never chosen, so it has no capital letters, digits or punctuation. Generate one and paste it here; your normal password cannot work.
connect.appPasswordLengthDetail: A {provider} app password is 16 characters. Check for a truncated copy and paste the whole thing.
connect.loginNameDetail: Some hosts issue a mail login that is not your email address. Enter the login name your provider gave you under Advanced settings.
connect.appPasswordTryAnyway: If you are sure this is right, press Connect again to send it.
connect.appPasswordStepsIcloud: Apple calls it an app-specific password. Sign in at account.apple.com, open Sign-In and Security, then App-Specific Passwords, and generate one. It is 16 lowercase letters, shown in four groups.
connect.appPasswordStepsYahoo: Yahoo calls it an app password. Open Account Security, then Generate app password. It is 16 lowercase letters with no spaces.
connect.appPasswordStepsZoho: Zoho calls it an application-specific password, in Zoho Account under Security. IMAP access also has to be on in Zoho Mail settings; it is off by default.
connect.appPasswordStepsYandex: Yandex calls it an app password. Enable IMAP and app passwords in Yandex Mail settings first, then create a Mail app password in Yandex ID under Security. It is 16 lowercase letters.
connect.appPasswordStepsFastmail: Fastmail calls it an app password. Open Settings, then Privacy and Security, then App Passwords, and create one with mail access. It is 16 lowercase characters.
connect.reconnectHint: Reconnecting this inbox: the address and server are locked. Just re-enter your app password to restore access.

connect.usernamePlaceholder: Leave blank to use your email address
connect.usernameHint: Only needed if your provider uses a separate login username instead of your email address. Check your provider's mail settings (e.g. "Username" or "Account name").
connect.advancedHint: Ports, security modes and a separate login username. The defaults work for almost every mailbox.
connect.hostPasteHint: You can paste the host with its port, like imap.example.com:993.
connect.hostPrefillNote: Recognised {provider}. The server settings below are filled in for you.
connect.hostPrefillAppPassword: {provider} needs an app password, not your normal account password.
connect.portMovedNote: Moved port {port} into the {protocol} port field under Advanced settings.
connect.passwordHint: Use your mailbox password. If your provider has 2-step verification (e.g. Gmail, Outlook, iCloud), generate an app password instead. The credential is encrypted before storage.
connect.discardBody: You've entered details that haven't been saved yet. If you close now, they'll be lost.
connect.imapLeadBody: IMAP and SMTP connect straight to your mail server, with no third-party consent screen in the way. Use this for a work mailbox, a custom domain, or any provider not listed here.
connect.googleStepsIntro: Google shows a caution screen before it hands access to any app it has not reviewed. Here is what you will see and how to get through it.
connect.googleConsentAlt: You will see this icon on Google’s screen, next to the mcpemails.com name.
connect.googleStep1: Pick your Google account and check the access you are granting.
connect.googleStep2: On the screen headed “Google hasn’t verified this app”, choose Advanced.
connect.googleStepsWhy: “Unsafe” is Google’s standard wording for a developer it has not reviewed. It is not a finding about this app. Google’s review requires a paid third-party security assessment we have chosen not to buy.
connect.googleStepsDuration: Once connected, the inbox stays connected. Access renews automatically in the background and stops only if you revoke it from your Google account.
connect.hintGeneric: Works with any mailbox that speaks IMAP and SMTP.
connect.hintIcloud: iCloud needs two-factor authentication and an app-specific password. Your Apple Account password will be rejected.
connect.hintYahoo: Yahoo needs a generated app password. Your normal Yahoo password will be rejected. Turn on two-step verification first, then create the app password.
connect.hintZoho: Turn on IMAP access in Zoho first: Settings → Mail Accounts → IMAP Access is off by default. With two-factor on, also generate an application-specific password.
connect.hintYandex: In Yandex Mail → Settings, enable IMAP and turn on app passwords and OAuth tokens. Both are required. Then generate an app password in Yandex ID.
connect.hintFastmail: Fastmail connects with a generated app password. Your normal Fastmail password will be rejected.
connect.zohoAccountTypeHint: Paid accounts on a custom domain use Zoho’s organization (imappro) servers.
connect.yandexAccountTypeHint: Personal accounts normally use the name before @. Business accounts use the full email address.
connect.yandexLoginHint: Optional manual override for unusual account configurations.
connect.securityPortNote: Changing this sets the matching standard port.
connect.appPasswordHint: An app password generated by {provider}, not your normal account password. It is encrypted before storage.
